name: Insert Fee Type
script:
fin_yr = frappe.form_dict.fin_yr
fee_type = frappe.form_dict.fee_type
desc = frappe.form_dict.desc

doc = frappe.get_doc({
    'doctype': "Fee Type",
    'type': fee_type,
    'description': desc,
    'financial_year': fin_yr
})
doc.insert()

name: Insert Fee Category
script:
doc = frappe.get_doc({
    'doctype': "Fee Category",
    "category_name": frappe.form_dict.fee_head,
  "fee_type": frappe.form_dict.fee_type,
  "fee_flag": frappe.form_dict.flag,
  "financial_year": frappe.form_dict.fin_yr,
  "frequency": frappe.form_dict.fq,
  "email_list": frappe.form_dict.email,
})
doc.insert()
